entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon planeswalker who rules Amonkhet and is worshipped as the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who watches Naktamun and is horrified by its cruelty.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who distrusts Amonkhet and promises dissent.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who senses death throughout the plane.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who admires the mummy embalmers.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker necromancer who finds it easy to command the dead on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers who did not expect to find perfection on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God of solidarity of Amonkhet whose symbol is the cat and who urges initiates to work together.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God of knowledge of Amonkhet who sets puzzles and the Trial of Knowledge.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God of ambition of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God of zeal of Amonkhet who favors those who fight for her.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God of strength of Amonkhet who oversees the Trial of Strength.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: Vizier of Naktamun who praises the mummy-run system and distrusts dissenters.

entities.name: Ukhat
entities.description: Vizier of initiation.

entities.name: Neponem
entities.description: Vizier of Kefnet who warns of the Luxa River.

entities.name: Senifet
entities.description: Vizier of Bontu.

entities.name: Epnokep
entities.description: Vizier of Bontu.

entities.name: Anep
entities.description: Vizier of Hazoret.

entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: Vizier of poisons.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Initiate of Tah crop who urges leaving the unworthy behind.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: Initiate of Tah crop who questions what lies beyond the Hekma and refuses to fight only for the honor of dying.

entities.name: Etha
entities.description: Initiate of Rhet crop.

entities.name: Pytamun
entities.description: Initiate of Nef crop.

entities.name: Neheb
entities.description: Initiate of Ahn crop.

entities.name: Ixor
entities.description: Initiate of Rhet crop.

entities.name: Minaldra
entities.description: The Vizag Atum.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Desert plane ruled by Nicol Bolas, with two suns and no night.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City of Amonkhet where initiates train for the trials.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: Barrier created by the God-Pharaoh to protect the city from the horrors beyond.

entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: River that brings life to Naktamun.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: Wasteland of Amonkhet beyond the city with giant spiders and hyenas.

entities.name: Shefet
entities.description: Region of scouring sands and rocky terrain.

entities.name: Ifnir
entities.description: Wasteland dotted with monuments.

entities.name: Gauntlet
entities.description: Training ground where initiates practice destructive techniques.

entities.name: Obelisk Path
entities.description: Path walked by initiates.

entities.name: Trials
entities.description: Series of trials undertaken by initiates for a place in the afterlife.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: Curse that turns the dead into restless wanderers who spread their curse.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: Sun of Amonkhet; its position marks the Hours of the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Hour of Revelation
entities.description: First of the Hours, begun when the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon.

entities.name: The Accounting of Hours
entities.description: Text describing the Hours of the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane whose fate is uncertain.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: Plane whose embrace is harsh.

events.summary: Gideon observes that the gods walk among the people but are not with them.
events.quote: The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them.

events.summary: The Gatewatch is surprised to find perfection on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.

events.summary: Gideon watches an initiate murder his crop-mate and his admiration of Naktamun turns to horror.
events.quote: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

events.summary: Djeru tells Samut they must leave the unworthy behind.
events.quote: We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut.

events.summary: Djeru shows a cursed minotaur as a warning of what awaits those who fail.
events.quote: That is what awaits us if we fail.

events.summary: Chandra says she likes Amonkhet less the more she sees.
events.quote: The more I see of this place, the less I want to.

events.summary: Chandra declares dissent is about to break out among the gods.
events.quote: Your gods can't even begin to comprehend the dissent that's about to happen here!

events.summary: Nissa senses death permeating the plane.
events.quote: Death has seeped into every part of this plane.

events.summary: Liliana finds it easy to command the dead on Amonkhet.
events.quote: The nature of this plane makes it almost too easy for me to command the dead.

events.summary: Liliana remains unmoved by the sight of angels.
events.quote: Angels? My feelings remain unchanged.

events.summary: Jace admires the mummy embalmers.
events.quote: They might be dead, but these mummies are masters of their trade.

events.summary: Samut questions what lies beyond the Hekma and the reach of the gods.
events.quote: Don't you ever wonder what lies beyond the Hekma?

events.summary: Samut declares she will no longer fight just for the honor of dying.
events.quote: I'll fight no more just for the honor of dying.

events.summary: Temmet praises a system in which the dead do all the work and the living only train.
events.quote: The dead perform all the work here

events.summary: Temmet notes that some refuse to appreciate the God-Pharaoh's gifts.
events.quote: there are those who refuse to appreciate all that the God-Pharaoh provides for us.

events.summary: Ukhat tells initiates to take comfort in the God-Pharaoh's presence.
events.quote: you can feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh. Take comfort in that.

events.summary: Oketra urges initiates to stand with their crop and become the storm.
events.quote: Stand with your crop. Become the storm.

events.summary: Hazoret tells initiates that only one will be honored by her spear.
events.quote: only one of you will be honored by my spear.

events.summary: Rhonas tells initiates they will overcome the trial's dangers or feed them.
events.quote: You will overcome them, or you will feed them.

events.summary: Kefnet teaches that a trained mind can explore the impossible.
events.quote: A trained mind can explore the impossible.

events.summary: Bontu tells initiates that ambition requires abandoning doubts.
events.quote: If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned.

events.summary: Acolytes walk along the Hekma, staring at the horrors the God-Pharaoh's barrier keeps at bay.
events.quote: staring out at the ravenous horrors kept at bay by the God-Pharaoh's barrier

events.summary: The Accounting of Hours foretells the God-Pharaoh tearing down the Hekma at the Hour of Promise.
events.quote: When the Hour of Promise arrives, the God-Pharaoh will tear down the Hekma

events.summary: The Hours begin when the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon.
events.quote: When the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon, so begins the Hour of Revelation.

events.summary: Pytamun recalls seeing a shadow-dark figure taller than the gods beyond the Hekma as a child.
events.quote: shadow-dark, and taller than the gods

events.summary: Neheb boasts that ashes cannot be embalmed.
events.quote: Ashes can't be embalmed.

relations.note: Oketra coaches initiates in the trial of solidarity.
relations.quote: Fly as an arrow through the trials, and never waver in your course.
a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas
The God-Pharaoh created the Hekma to protect us from the horrors beyond

relations.note: Temmet is a vizier serving the God-Pharaoh.
relations.quote: there are those who refuse to appreciate all that the God-Pharaoh provides for us.
Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity.
To be worthy of the next life, you must never look back.
The Luxa River is a snake, and it can swallow you whole.
We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut.
